title: From a Dad With 4 Jobs to $100 Million
description:
His dad worked up to 4 jobs at once. Now he earns 100 million dollars a year.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Lewis Hamilton: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lewis_Hamilton
- Wikipedia: Forbes list of the world's highest-paid athletes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_list_of_the_world%27s_highest-paid_athletes

From Wikipedia (Lewis Hamilton): his father sometimes worked up to four jobs at a time to fund his racing; his father bought him a go-kart for Christmas when he was six; at ten, the youngest British cadet karting champion, he told McLaren's Ron Dennis he wanted to race his cars one day; he has won a joint-record seven World Drivers' Championships and holds the record for most wins (106). Forbes 2026 list (Wikipedia: highest-paid athletes): $100 million ($70M salary and winnings, $30M endorsements). Not financial advice.

cta: Fast car or big trophy? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: His dad worked up to 4 jobs at once. Now he earns 100 million dollars a year.
It started with a go-kart for Christmas. He was just six.
At ten, he told a team boss he'd race his cars.
Then he did. Seven world titles. A record 106 wins.
But only 70 million is from racing. Sponsors pay the rest.
